description: Returns a GitHub App install URL so the user can grant BotKelp read access to one of their repos. Open the URL, pick a single repo, approve. Then purchase_scaffold template_files: [{ source: "app/legal/" }] copies those pages into the clone. disconnect: true drops the connection. Prefer signing in with GitHub on botkelp.com first.

disconnect.description: true: drop the connected repo. Omit to mint a fresh install URL.

name: set_github
title: Connect or disconnect GitHub
